tagline: See your site on an iPhone or a Pixel, tomorrow morning, in Arabic or in dark mode, from a panel inside the page
hero_hint: The panel on the right edge of this page is devknobs itself. Press D or click knobs, then pick a phone.
how_frame: Pick a device and your page loads again in a same-origin frame of that exact size. Media queries, innerWidth, vw units and fixed elements all see a real viewport.
how_patch: The other knobs change what your code reads: media queries, matchMedia, Date, Intl, navigator.language, geolocation and the user agent. Your CSS and your JavaScript see the same thing.
how_setup: One script tag or one import. No browser extension, no CSS to add, no code to change. Load it in development only.
feature_devices_detail: iPhone 18 Pro back to SE, Pixel 10 and 9, iPads, laptops and desktops. Phones wear their real body, with Safari or Chrome drawn around your page and bars that shrink as you scroll.
feature_touch_detail: Inside a phone, your mouse acts as a finger: touch events, drag to scroll, no hover. Find the menu that only opens on hover.
feature_grab_detail: Hold ⌘C (Ctrl+C off a Mac) and click an element. Its HTML, its React components and their file and line go to your clipboard for a coding agent.
feature_time_detail: Set the clock to next Friday or run it 60 times faster. Change the time zone and the position geolocation reports. Send the time to your own dev server in a header.
feature_language_detail: Any locale with its writing direction, for Intl and navigator.language. Pseudo-localized text, accented and padded, to see where longer words break your layout. A bigger default text size.
feature_look_detail: Dark mode, more contrast, reduced motion and color blindness filters. Slow every animation down, pause it, or replay it from the start.
feature_debug_detail: Mark every box that makes the page scroll sideways. Outline every element. Swap the user agent, or tell the page it is offline.
features_panel: The panel starts with a search field and works from the keyboard. Only the knobs you changed stay listed, and its footer shows five shortcuts.
features_readme: Every knob and how it works, in the README
try_intro: Each button turns a knob in the panel on this page. Reset puts everything back.
usage_react_note: In Next.js, gate the import itself with next/dynamic. A static import stays in the production bundle, even behind the check.
usage_early_note: Add it when your page reads a media query, the time or the user agent while it boots. It also lets grab name the file and line of every component.
limits_ua: There is no extension, so some things are emulated in the page. Your server still gets the real User-Agent header.
limits_touch: CSS :hover still follows the real mouse. Touch is one finger, with no pinch and no long press menu.
limits_phone: env(safe-area-inset-*) stays 0. There is no keyboard, and Safari's tabs and share sheet do not open.
limits_clock: The clock moves the time the page reads, not timers. setTimeout and performance.now keep real time.
limits_devtools: Forced colors, print and real network throttling still need the browser devtools.
limits_bezels: The iPhone and Pixel bezel images belong to Apple and Google and are not under the MIT license.
